description: Receives email through the UnitySVC SMTP gateway and forwards it to the customer's HTTP endpoint as the platform `msg` envelope (`{title, body, type, format}`) — the body `notify` and the `msg-to-*` services accept, and the shape an apprise-api `/notify/{key}` or mailrise receiver takes. The upstream URL is resolved from the customer secret `DEMO_HTTP_RELAY_BASE_URL`.
name: smtp-to-apprise
